title: A Quasi-Pentagon Equation for a Heisenberg Double of a Quasi-Hopf Algebra
summary: For a finite-dimensional Hopf algebra $H$, the canonical elements of the Heisenberg doubles $\mathcal{H}(H^\ast)$ and $\mathcal{H}(H)$ satisfy the pentagon and Hopf equations, respectively. In this paper we construct quasi-Hopf analogues of these structures. For a finite-dimensional quasi-Hopf algebra $H$, we consider natural quasi-Hopf analogues $\mathcal{H}_1(H^\ast)$ and $\mathcal{H}_1(H)$ of $\mathcal{H}(H^\ast)$ and $\mathcal{H}(H)$.
